# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for the TSan CI job.
#
# Keep this list short: each entry hides a known, tracked problem and should
# be removed when that problem is fixed.

# Thread::Terminate() cancels threads asynchronously (pthread_cancel with
# PTHREAD_CANCEL_ASYNCHRONOUS), so the cancellation unwind runs destructors
# inside the cancellation signal. Tracked as the async-cancellation issue;
# remove once termination is cooperative.
signal:xe::threading::PosixCondition<xe::threading::Thread>::ThreadStartRoutine
